components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: RotaTeq is a live, oral pentavalent vaccine that contains 5 live reassortant rotaviruses.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each vaccine dose contains sucrose,
sodium citrate, sodium phosphate monobasic monohydrate, sodium hydroxide, polysorbate 80, cell culture
media, and trace amounts of fetal bovine serum. RotaTeq contains no preservatives.

allergens.quote:
The ampule
and the plastic tube and cap do not contain latex.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
RotaTeq is contraindicated in infants with a demonstrated history of hypersensitivity to any component
of the vaccine.

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote: The ampule, and the plastic tube and cap do not contain latex.
